# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This manual accompanies the **Regional Training Course on Experimental Design and Data Analysis for the Advancement of Mutant Populations** (IAEA project RER5030), held at the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences and Food, Skopje, North Macedonia, 9–20 November 2026.

## How to use this manual

- Each chapter matches one or more sessions of the agenda.
- Every chapter follows the same structure: learning objectives, key concepts, a worked demo in R, interpretation for breeding decisions, an exercise and key takeaways.
- All code uses the shared datasets in the `data/` folder of the course repository.
- Slides for each session are condensed versions of the chapters.

## Setup

Run `R/install_packages.R` once to install all course packages. Participants with older computers can use [Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud/plans/free).
